title: Lifecycle validation and gap diagnostics
description: Validate lifecycle structure and emit object-targeted traceability gap diagnostics through plugin validators and the existing four-level diagnostic model.
completion_criteria: Core validators detect duplicate IDs, missing refs, invalid registered relations, schema mismatch, cycles, and self-dependency.
Lifecycle validators warn on Requirement without AcceptanceCriterion, AcceptanceCriterion without Test, and required Test without Evidence.
Every lifecycle diagnostic targets the responsible object ID.
success_criteria: MVP AC-04, AC-05, AC-06, and AC-12 pass.
Lifecycle warnings are absent unless lifecycle is installed and never block legacy architecture rendering.
